استنشقا (form X)

# اُسْتُنْشِقَا (ustunšiqā) /us.tun.ʃi.qaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَنْشَقَ (istanšaqa)
# اِسْتَنْشِقَا (istanšiqā) /is.tan.ʃi.qaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَنْشَقَ (istanšaqa)
